selection_framework.corrosion: Select against actual chemistry, concentration, temperature, aeration, impurities and flow regime; nominal alloy family is insufficient.
selection_framework.localized_corrosion: Pitting, crevice corrosion and galvanic coupling can dominate even where general corrosion resistance is excellent.
selection_framework.stress_corrosion: Retain stress state, residual stress, environment and temperature in the material identity.
selection_framework.hydrogen: Hydrogen absorption and embrittlement/pickup are critical considerations for selected zirconium, titanium and high-strength alloy systems.
selection_framework.functional_alloys: For shape-memory/superelastic materials, transformation behaviour and functional fatigue are first-class engineering properties.
selection_framework.high_strength: Cold work and age treatment can materially change strength and ductility; condition is mandatory.

screening_matrix.need: very high strength plus corrosion resistance

rule: Corrosion resistance is an environment-specific property; strength and corrosion data must never be decoupled from material condition.
